lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance clusters; a primary row of approximately 6-7 distinct blobs is positioned immediately ventral to the lateral ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows to form a coarse grid-like pattern of local maxima across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge extends across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow transition along its longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution; two discrete high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, one near the anterior base and one medially.
